title: Sunder Leveling
subtitle: Level with Sunder, then swap to Righteous Fire at Blood Aqueducts.

content.text: This guide is designed to level you efficiently through the campaign using
, with the goal of transitioning into

(BA) at approximately level 52–55. Once you reach BA, you'll use the free respec points earned throughout the campaign, along with gold for any additional passive refunds, to fully transition into your chosen build. From there, you can follow the dedicated guides from Pohx, Emiracles, or SpicySushi for your skill setup, passive tree progression, gearing, and eventual transition into maps and endgame content.
